notablePrerequisites:
You have a way to cause Eternity Vessel to leave the battlefield at instant speed.
There is at least one counter of any kind on The Ozolith.
easyPrerequisites: Darksteel Reactor has at least as many charge counters on it as 20 minus your life total.
description:
At the beginning of combat, Mishra and The Ozolith trigger.
Resolve the Mishra trigger, creating an artifact creature token copy of Eternity Vessel that enters with a number of charge counters equal to your life total.
In response to the remaining trigger, cause Eternity Vessel to leave the battlefield.
The Ozolith triggers, putting a number of charge counters on itself equal to the charge counters that were on Eternity Vessel.
Resolve The Ozolith trigger from step 1, moving all counters from it onto Darksteel Reactor.
Darksteel Reactor triggers, causing you to win the game.
